```yaml
  name: tenant-a-upgrade

  tenantId: tenant-a

```

```yaml
}
```

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
- Validates understanding of namespace-scoped quotas and limits, a core tenancy control pattern in multi-tenant Kubernetes environments.

## Key Concepts
- ResourceQuota: Enforces aggregate resource limits across a namespace
- LimitRange: Defines default requests/limits and validates pod resource specifications
- Per-namespace isolation: Ensures tenants cannot exceed allocated resources
- Quota enforcement: Kubernetes rejects pods that would exceed quota limits
- Validation methods: kubectl describe quota and limitrange commands

## Code Example
```yaml
# Namespace: cnf-tenant-A
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: cnf-tenant-A

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ResourceQuota
metadata:
  name: cnf-tenant-A-quota
  namespace: cnf-tenant-A
spec:
  hard:
    limits.cpu: 4
    limits.memory: 16Gi
    requests.cpu: 2
    requests.memory: 8Gi

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: LimitRange
metadata:
  name: cnf-tenant-A-limits
  namespace: cnf-tenant-A
spec:
  limits:
  - default:
      cpu: 500m
      memory: 512Mi
    defaultRequest:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 128Mi
    type: Container
```

questions.explanation:
## Why This Question Matters
This question assesses your understanding of certificate rotation, CSR workflows, SPIFFE identities, and tenant isolation in Kubernetes-based CNF (Cloud-Native Function) gateway platforms. It validates your ability to design lifecycle management solutions that operate without downtime and your competence in developing testable configurations before production rollout.

## Key Concepts
- Per-tenant CSR issuance within Kubernetes
- Rotating CA with short-lived certificates for enhanced security
- SPIFFE identities and TLS handshakes in multi-tenant CNF gateways
- Tenant isolation using separate namespaces

## Solution Architecture

### 1. Minimal CA Manifest

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: tenant-ca
  namespace: cnf-gateway
type: kubernetes.io/tls
data:
  ca.crt: <base64-encoded-CA-certificate>
  ca.key: <base64-encoded-CA-private-key>
```

### 2. CSR Flow and Approval Policy

```yaml
apiVersion: certificates.k8s.io/v1
kind: CertificateSigningRequest
metadata:
  name: gateway-csr
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  groups:
  - system:authenticated
  request: <base64-encoded-CSR>
  signerName: kubernetes.io/kube-apiserver-client
  usages:
  - digital signature
  - key encipherment
  - client auth
---
apiVersion: certificates.k8s.io/v1
kind: CertificateSigningRequest
metadata:
  name: gateway-csr
spec:
  approval:
  - user: system:controller:certificates-approver
    approval: true
  conditions:
  - type: Approved
    reason: TenantIdentityValidated
    message: CSR identity matches tenant namespace
```

### 3. Per-Tenant CA Rotation Policy (30-Day Renewal)

```yaml
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Issuer
metadata:
  name: tenant-ca-issuer
  namespace: cnf-gateway
spec:
  ca:
    secretName: tenant-ca
---
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Certificate
metadata:
  name: gateway-cert
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  secretName: gateway-tls
  issuerRef:
    name: tenant-ca-issuer
    kind: Issuer
  commonName: gateway.tenant-a.cnf
  dnsNames:
  - gateway.tenant-a.cnf
  spiffeURIs:
  - spiffe://cnf/tenant-a/gateway
  duration: 720h # 30 days
  renewBefore: 168h # 7 days before expiry
  usages:
  - digital signature
  - key encipherment
  - client auth
  - server auth
```

### 4. Test Manifest with Sidecar Validation

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: tenant-a
  labels:
    tenant-id: tenant-a
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: gateway
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  ports:
  - port: 8443
    targetPort: 8443
  selector:
    app: gateway
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: gateway
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: gateway
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: gateway
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: gateway
        image: cnf-gateway:latest
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8443
        volumeMounts:
        - name: tls-certs
          mountPath: /etc/tls
          readOnly: true
        env:
        - name: SPIFFE_ID
          value: spiffe://cnf/tenant-a/gateway
      volumes:
      - name: tls-certs
        secret:
          secretName: gateway-tls
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: test-validator
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  restartPolicy: Never
  containers:
  - name: validator
    image: curl:latest
    command: ["sh", "-c"]
    args:
    - |
      # Validate TLS handshake
      openssl s_client -connect gateway:8443 \
        -CAfile /etc/tls/ca.crt \
        -cert /etc/tls/tls.crt \
        -key /etc/tls/tls.key \
        -verify_return_error
    volumeMounts:
    - name: tls-certs
      mountPath: /etc/tls
      readOnly: true
  volumes:
  - name: tls-certs
    secret:
      secretName: gateway-tls
```

### 5. SPIFFE Identity Validation

Each tenant receives a SPIFFE identity in the format `spiffe://cnf/{tenant}/gateway`. The CSR approval policy validates that the requested identity matches the tenant's namespace before issuance, ensuring strict tenant isolation.

## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates understanding of tenant isolation, mTLS, and certificate rotation using cert-manager in a CNF (Cloud-Native Function) gateway context. It also assesses practical knowledge of in-cluster secret management and sidecar integration patterns.

## Key Concepts
- Kubernetes Secrets and per-tenant namespace isolation
- Mutual TLS termination in a gateway sidecar
- cert-manager Issuers and automatic certificate rotation
- Tenant identity extraction from X.509 certificates

## Code Example
```yaml
# Per-tenant CA Issuer
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Issuer
metadata:
  name: tenant-ca-issuer
  namespace: tenant-namespace
spec:
  ca:
    secretName: tenant-ca-cert
---
# Certificate with auto-rotation
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Certificate
metadata:
  name: tenant-server-tls
  namespace: tenant-namespace
spec:
  secretName: tenant-<id>-tls
  issuerRef:
    name: tenant-ca-issuer
    kind: Issuer
  duration: 168h
  renewBefore: 72h
  dnsNames:
    - gateway.tenant-namespace.svc.cluster.local
  subject:
    organizations:
      - tenant-<id>
---
# Gateway Deployment with mTLS sidecar
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: cnf-gateway
  namespace: tenant-namespace
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: gateway
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8443
        volumeMounts:
        - name: tls-certs
          mountPath: /etc/tls
          readOnly: true
      - name: mtls-sidecar
        image: mtls-proxy:latest
        ports:
        - containerPort: 9443
        env:
        - name: TENANT_CA_PATH
          value: /etc/certs/ca.crt
        - name: VALIDATE_CLIENT_CERTS
          value: "true"
        volumeMounts:
        - name: tls-certs
          mountPath: /etc/tls
          readOnly: true
        - name: tenant-ca
          mountPath: /etc/certs
          readOnly: true
      volumes:
      - name: tls-certs
        secret:
          secretName: tenant-<id>-tls
      - name: tenant-ca
        secret:
          secretName: tenant-ca-cert
```

## Validation One-Namespace Manifest
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: tenant-001
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: tenant-ca-cert
  namespace: tenant-001
type: kubernetes.io/tls
data:
  tls.crt: <base64-encoded-ca-cert>
  tls.key: <base64-encoded-ca-key>
---
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Issuer
metadata:
  name: tenant-ca-issuer
  namespace: tenant-001
spec:
  ca:
    secretName: tenant-ca-cert
---
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Certificate
metadata:
  name: tenant-001-tls
  namespace: tenant-001
spec:
  secretName: tenant-001-tls
  issuerRef:
    name: tenant-ca-issuer
    kind: Issuer
  duration: 168h
  renewBefore: 72h
  dnsNames:
    - gateway.tenant-001.svc.cluster.local
  subject:
    organizations:
      - tenant-001
```

## Key Implementation Details
1. **Certificate Rotation**: cert-manager automatically renews certificates before expiration using the `renewBefore` field
2. **Tenant Isolation**: Each tenant has isolated namespaces, CAs, and TLS secrets
3. **mTLS Validation**: The sidecar validates client certificates against the tenant-specific CA
